original_target.title: Pansu's isoperimetric conjecture in the Heisenberg group

scope_comparison: The source claims sharp horizontal isoperimetry for every measurable finite-perimeter positive-finite-volume set, with no regularity or symmetry restriction. Its fields use t-normalization twice that of the local statement. The change(x,y,t)->(x,y,-2t) carries the local horizontal fields to the source fields and the displayed bubble to the source Pansu ball. Both volume and horizontal perimeter acquire factor2, so the equal-volume comparison is exactly preserved.
